title: Cooling system drain, refill and air bleed
parts: Coolant of the correct type for the engine
warnings: Never open a hot radiator cap
Don't mix coolant chemistries (green IAT, Dexcool OAT, Asian pink/blue, European G-series). Flush fully when switching.
Coolant is toxic and sweet-tasting to pets. Clean up spills.
steps: Engine cold. Open the radiator drain (petcock) or pull the lower hose; remove the cap to speed draining.
Optional flush: close it up, fill with water, run to temperature with heater on high, cool, drain. Repeat until clear.
Close the drain. Fill with the correct mix (usually 50/50).
Bolt a spill-free funnel to the radiator/reservoir neck and fill it halfway.
Open any bleeder screws on the thermostat housing or heater hoses until coolant (not air) comes out, then close.
Heater on max, start the engine, idle. Squeeze the upper hose to burp bubbles.
Run until the thermostat opens (upper hose gets hot, level drops in the funnel). Keep it topped up.
Bump rpm to about 2000 for a minute to push out remaining air. When bubbles stop, plug the funnel, remove it and install the cap.
Fill the overflow tank to the COLD line. Recheck after the next full cool-down.
